endorsements.name: Kishore Hariram
endorsements.label: CVE-2021-24301
endorsements.description: The Hotjar Connecticator WordPress plugin through 1.1.1 is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in the 'hotjar script' textarea. The request did include a CSRF nonce that was properly verified by the server and this vulnerability could only be exploited by administrator users.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE
